description: This file contains base classes and core logic for integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) with function calling support within a service framework. It defines the primary LLMService class, function registration and execution mechanisms, event handlers, and communication with external adapters, particularly for OpenAI-compatible models. The file supports both parallel and sequential invocation modes, and includes detailed handling of function call lifecycle events.

classes.name: FunctionCallResultCallback
classes.description: Protocol for function call result callbacks handling the result of an LLM function execution.

classes.name: FunctionCallParams
classes.description: Parameters for a function call, encapsulating details like function name, arguments, context, and callback.

classes.name: FunctionCallRegistryItem
classes.description: Represents a registered function handler, including metadata such as cancellation behavior and whether it's a direct function.

classes.name: FunctionCallRunnerItem
classes.description: Internal structure representing a scheduled function call execution, including context and execution parameters.

classes.name: LLMService
classes.description: Base class for all Large Language Model services, managing function registration, invocation, event handling, and communication with adapters.
